def third_smallest_distinct(nums):
    """Return the third smallest value among the DISTINCT values of nums (duplicates count once). If nums has fewer than 3 distinct values, return None.
    >>> third_smallest_distinct([-1, -1, 0, 3, 3])
    3
    >>> third_smallest_distinct([1, -45, 47, -25, 4, -37, -5, 34, -29, -20, -1, 18])
    -29
    >>> third_smallest_distinct([])
    """
